'''Barel Layden''' is an [[Andoran]] noble of a minor House.

== Appearance ==
He is lanky.

== Activities ==
He enters [[Caemlyn]] quietly when [[Rand al'Thor]] disposes of Lord Gaebril. 

He is one of the nobles to have thrown their support behind [[Elayne Trakand]] and brought their armsmen to [[Caemlyn]].

When Elayne is captured by the [[Black Ajah]], he and his armsmen ride to aid [[Birgitte Silverbow]] in rescuing her.
